name: RAYTHEON TECHNOLOGIES CORP
summary: RAYTHEON TECHNOLOGIES CORP is an aerospace and defense company that provides advanced technology and services to governments and commercial customers worldwide. Headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, the company operates through four segments: Collins Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, Raytheon Intelligence & Space, and Raytheon Missiles & Defense. Raytheon Technologies develops and manufactures a wide range of products, including aircraft engines, avionics, cybersecurity solutions, missiles, and radar systems.
